verdicts.notes: A is the only screen doing this job: per-section "Modifier" affordances scoped to cheminement and cote R, tag copy that states the payoff and the privacy limit ("Sert à faire remonter des bourses auxquelles tu pourrais être admissible. Jamais partagé ni vendu."), and a sourced figure line with a date. Its weaknesses are real — the delete trigger looks like text, "Préparer ma rencontre" never says with whom or what happens next, and a dead grey band sits between the delete card and the footer — but they are craft debts on a screen that is otherwise honest and legible. B is a social profile with no edit-return path, no consequence copy, and text physically covered by a floating button, so the comparison is not close.

verdicts.gapA: A is not a bursaries screen and is not even a clean screen capture: the top ~17% of the frame is marketing copy ("Customize the Explore feed to show things that interest you") sitting above a device mockup, so the first thing read is an ad, not the content. Inside the mockup there are no matched/close/other sections and no why-chips anywhere — the feed is "MORE LIKE THIS", "Today on Wikipedia — Main page on 25 Jun 2019", "Randomizer — Flip through random articles to read from Wikipedia.", "Featured article — 20 Jun 2019", "Echo parakeet". Closing that gap means replacing the whole frame with an actual sectioned, chip-annotated list; nothing short of that moves my pick.
verdicts.gapB: In the top "Admissible maintenant" section, the "Bourses Perspective Québec (TI, Génie, Santé, Éducation)" card — the second-largest amount on the screen, "2 500 $ – 20 000 $" — carries no why-chip at all. It goes from "Gouvernement du Québec (MES)  2 500 $ – 20 000 $" straight to the hairline divider, then "28 février 2027 / Postuler", with no "Ton programme" / "Ta cote R" / "Ouvert à tous" pill and no requirements line, while all eleven sibling cards have one. That single card breaks the "why-chips on every card" rule and, because it is the richest offer in the eligible band, it is the one a student most needs a reason for.
violationsA: Figures shown with no source and no verification date: "Main page on 25 Jun 2019" in the green "Today on Wikipedia" band and the bare "20 Jun 2019" in the "Featured article" header.

Truncated/clipped content: the top row "MORE LIKE THIS" is an orphaned card footer whose card is cut off above the frame, and the "Echo parakeet — Species of parrot endemic to Mauritius" card is sliced mid-body at the bottom edge.
violationsB: Header badge reads "COTE R 31,20 CONFIRMÉE" — a self-entered figure labelled "confirmed" with no adjacent source, verification date, or "ta saisie" marker; the only disclosure, "Ta cote R est celle que tu as saisie", sits in the footer roughly eight screens below and is invisible at the point the number is read.

Chip "Cote min. 32,0 : à 0,8 de ta cote" on the "Bourse Schulich Leader" card states a third-party cutoff and a derived gap inline with no marker separating the sourced cutoff from the computed distance; the gap figure is a derivation presented in the same weight as verified data.
verdicts.notes: B is the only screen doing the job, and mostly doing it honestly: three colour-coded bands ("Admissible maintenant" green, "À portée" rust, "À explorer" grey), per-card "Vérifié le 24 août 2026 · quebec.ca" provenance, honest empty states ("Aucune date limite publiée", "Pas de formulaire en ligne. Contacte les services aux étudiants de ton cégep."), and 96px-tall "Postuler" pills that clear the touch-target bar. Its real craft weakness is sameness: twelve near-identical white cards differ only by a heading colour, "À explorer" is grey-on-grey and nearly disappears, and deadlines appear as bare unlabelled dates ("15 octobre 2026") even though the empty case is labelled — so the reader must infer what the date means. A is a store marketing asset, not a screen under test, and fails the section/chip criterion outright.

verdicts.gapA: A never attempts the brief: it is a store-listing composite whose top half is spent on the marketing headline "Customizable / Many customization options, encryption and backups", and the UI inside the phone frame is an "Appearance" list (Theme, Dynamic colors, Language, View mode, Show icons) with no notification toggles, no per-row consequence copy, and no guest/signed-in state anywhere. Even taken as a settings screen, its bottom row "Show the account name" is sliced off by the frame and rows like "Theme — Selected: Light theme" carry no chevron or any other cue that they are tappable.
verdicts.gapB: The persistent top bar is the weakest region: "COTE R" is crushed into a two-line stack ("COTE" over "R") jammed against "31,20 CONFIRMÉE", so the one hard number on screen is both mangled typographically and carries a confidence word with no source or verification date beside it — the provenance ("Ta cote R est celle que tu as saisie") is stranded in the footer far below. Fixing that bar (single-line label, "saisie par toi · <date>" next to the value) would remove the only honesty and craft wound on an otherwise clean screen.
violationsA: Bottom row 'Show the account name' is truncated — the label sits on the frame edge and its description is clipped away entirely.
violationsB: Top bar figure '31,20 CONFIRMÉE' shows a confidence word with no source and no verification date adjacent; the 'celle que tu as saisie' provenance is only in the page footer.
Top-bar label 'COTE R' wraps mid-label into a two-line stack against the value — a mangled label in a persistent chrome element.
verdicts.notes: B is the only screen that answers the brief: four toggles each with a concrete consequence line ("jusqu'à 14 jours avant l'échéance", "décembre et avril"), a plain-language scope card up top, and an explicit device-local guest state ("Enregistré sur cet appareil. Connecte-toi pour retrouver ces choix sur tes autres appareils.") with a real "Me connecter" target — and no push block invented where nothing backs it. Its faults are the cramped header and a dead vertical gap between the sign-in card and the legal footer that wastes about a screen-third. A is a marketing frame around an unrelated Appearance list with a cropped final row and rows that give no affordance, so it loses on criterion before craft is even weighed.
